notes.title: Meridian Global -- Technical Requirements
notes.body:
Jonathan needs:
1. API rate limits of 10,000 req/min
2. Custom SSO/SAML integration
3. Multi-region data residency (US, EU, APAC)
4. Audit log retention of 7 years

He is comparing us with Salesforce. Our API flexibility is our key advantage.

notes.title: Athena Health -- Integration Complexity
notes.body:
Epic EHR integration requires:
- HL7 FHIR R4 compliance
- HIPAA BA agreement signed
- On-site security review
- Data migration from legacy system

This is a complex but high-value deal. Estimated 6-month implementation.

notes.title: Titan Defense -- Security Clearance Notes
notes.body:
All team members working on this deployment need:
- Active security clearance (Secret level minimum)
- NDAs signed and on file
- Access to secure facility for deployment

Carol is coordinating clearance verification.

notes.title: Pioneer Retail -- ERP Integration Notes
notes.body:
Current ERP: SAP S/4HANA
Integration points:
- Inventory synchronization (real-time)
- Order management
- Customer data
- Pricing and promotions

Their IT team prefers REST APIs over file-based integration.

notes.title: Crown Industries -- Post-Sale Notes
notes.body:
Deal closed! Key contacts:
- Heinrich Weber (CTO) -- primary stakeholder
- Klaus Schmidt (Plant Manager) -- implementation lead

Next steps:
- Kickoff meeting July 1st
- Phase 1: MES integration (months 1-6)
- Phase 2: IoT pipeline (months 4-8)

notes.title: Summit Ventures -- Custom Requirements
notes.body:
William needs:
1. Deal flow tracking with pipeline stages
2. Investor reporting with PDF generation
3. Portfolio company performance dashboard
4. Cap table management

This could expand to a firm-wide deployment if successful.
